en.text:
Aiming Down Sights for #e${1.5-#d} seconds without firing causes your next kill to trigger an explosion matching the weapon's element within an 8 meter radius, experiencing a maximum of 30% damage falloff.

Timer starts as soon as ADS input is pressed. Unscoping immediately removes the buff.
